1.TITLE: Always up to date

2.TITLE: Vote for the FENECON Home 6, 10 & 15!
2.TEXT: You can vote for our Home 6, 10 & 15 until early May in this year’s reader poll hosted by the building technology industry portal haustec.de. 37 products and 34 brands are competing in 9 categories for the title of Best Product of 2026.
